Write plainly; every claim below was verified by the reviewer on 2026-10-09 and may be stated as fact with the evidence given.

FINDING A (ROADMAP:137, 'Keep the controlling rollout sequence in the roadmap'): the branch's ROADMAP paragraph says the ops doc 'supersedes this paragraph' while the ops doc's authority note says the roadmap controls. Remove the circularity: the ROADMAP keeps the controlling remaining sequence and gates; the ops doc is linked ONLY as dated verified evidence and tooling-status. Rewrite the ROADMAP correction paragraph (lines ~134-141 on the branch) to: (1) state the verified facts briefly, (2) give the controlling remaining sequence in one ordered list: register 010/011/013 after 014 -> governed plan/apply -> fresh non-published 010-aware derived generation -> system_search build with body-type counts -> system_archetype build -> validate both READY -> validate the 18 deferred CHECK constraints (see below) -> publish_derived_generation -> revise the release gate -> governed app release/promote of main, (3) link docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md as evidence. In the ops doc's 'Authority note', delete the sentence claiming the roadmap's claims 'have been corrected to point here' and keep: roadmap controls; this file is dated evidence; divergence means correct the roadmap. In docs/development/v3-finder-delivery-plan.md change '(authoritative)' in the inserted paragraph to '(verified evidence; the sequence is controlled by docs/ROADMAP.md)'.

FINDING B (ops doc line ~62, 'Keep manifest registration pending until the PR merges'): step 1 must read PENDING, not 'done, PR open', with this verified reason: PR #780 was based on main 5fbb978 and is superseded. On 2026-10-06 PR #782 (abaf3f5) registered 014_v3_watchlist.sql after 012 in sql/v3/migration-manifest.txt (lineage through-012-014, migration-set identity sha256:7511a66d438a6413153be3d5515622e007c58ee722c2c5ae39d6ed2adc3e6684, authority transition from the installed through-012 identity sha256:17263a9748eb936d3c6a7f3e3f75224a40d5e48e011276aedf511946abfff4fe). The V3 lineage is an exact-prefix, append-only ledger (scripts/operator/v3_production_migrate.py plan_migrations), so 010/011 must now be appended AFTER 014; #780's manifest, authority JSON and lineage tests are all stale against main. A fresh registration PR on top of main will replace #780.

NEW VERIFIED FACTS to add to the ops doc (keep 'As of 2026-10-04' for the production inspection; add a dated 'Update 2026-10-09' note saying these are repository/workflow facts, not a new production inspection):
1. No production migration or deployment workflow has run since 2026-09-25 (v3-production-schema-migration.yml last ran 2026-09-23; v3-production-application-deploy.yml last ran 2026-09-25; chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml last ran 2026-09-22), so the 2026-10-04 inspection still describes production. 014 is registered but NOT applied; today's pending set in production is [014].
2. Migration 010 as committed CANNOT be applied by the bounded runner and must be rewritten before step 2. Evidence: scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py COMMAND_TIMEOUT = 120 kills the psql apply; 010 adds 18 CHECK constraints inline, and PostgreSQL validates new CHECK constraints by scanning the whole table under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE. Measured on PostgreSQL 18.4 with a 10,000,000-row, 1.35 GB cached table: two inline CHECKs took 1.46 s (full scan); adding the same columns with no CHECK took 1.2 ms; adding the CHECKs NOT VALID took 0.4 ms. Production v3_derived.system_search holds the superseded opt1 product, about 198.5 million wide rows on VPS disk, so the scan is minutes under a lock that blocks every Finder search, then the runner kills it at 120 s and the transaction rolls back. The rewrite: add the 18 columns (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, metadata-only in PG18), add the 18 CHECKs NOT VALID with the same names PostgreSQL would have generated (system_search_<column>_check), keep the view recreate, and use 014's SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s' / statement_timeout='30s' pattern. NOT VALID constraints are enforced for every subsequent INSERT/UPDATE; every existing row satisfies them by construction (DEFAULT 0, and 004 already enforces landable_count >= 0 so walkable_count BETWEEN 0 AND landable_count holds). The repository already uses NOT VALID -> VALIDATE for large constraints (001_v3_baseline.sql line ~1520).
3. Therefore the remaining path gains a step: VALIDATE CONSTRAINT for the 18 checks is a separate governed operation outside the migration runner (SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE: does not block reads or the builder's inserts; it is a full scan, minutes), tooling to be built with the step 5/7 actions. Mark its tooling status as 'must be built'.
4. 013_v3_system_search_parallel.sql (two empty scheduler tables, no FK to populated relations) will be registered in the same fresh registration PR, after 011, so the parallel chunk-range rebuild (docs/development/system-search-parallel-rebuild.md, code-only, rollout never executed) becomes available for step 4; registration does not authorize or execute it.
5. Add an open decision under the remaining path: the fresh build inserts a second ~198.5 million-row product into the same v3_derived.system_search table alongside opt1's rows; retention or purge of superseded generations' product rows, and the disk headroom for the build, are undecided and must be decided before step 4 is dispatched. State it as a decision, not a measurement.
Also update the ROADMAP line ~123 claim that 010/011 'are not wired into the manifest' only if it is still accurate (it is) — keep it, but add that 014 now sits between 012 and the Finder migrations.

Keep the existing 'Verified production state' table and the 'watch-list' section; extend the table with a row noting 014: registered 2026-10-06, not applied. Do not change the step numbering beyond inserting the constraint-validation step (renumber consistently).
